## Packages

```{r}

packages <- c(
  "sf",
  "leaflet",
  "dplyr",
  "tidyr",
  "stringr",
  "jsonlite",
  "htmlwidgets",
  "htmltools",
  "maps",
  "RColorBrewer",
  "scales",
  "tibble"
)

```



## Identify the six priority variables

```{r}

priority_fields <- c(
  "Priority 1_CHNA",
  "Priority 2_CHNA",
  "Priority 3_CHNA",
  "Priority 1_IPLAN",
  "Priority 2_IPLAN",
  "Priority 3_IPLAN"
)

missing_priorities <- setdiff(
  priority_fields,
  names(analysis_data)
)

if (length(missing_priorities) > 0) {
  stop(
    paste(
      "Missing priority columns:",
      paste(missing_priorities, collapse = ", ")
    )
  )
}

priority_labels <- c(
  "Priority 1_CHNA" = "CHNA Priority 1",
  "Priority 2_CHNA" = "CHNA Priority 2",
  "Priority 3_CHNA" = "CHNA Priority 3",
  "Priority 1_IPLAN" = "IPLAN Priority 1",
  "Priority 2_IPLAN" = "IPLAN Priority 2",
  "Priority 3_IPLAN" = "IPLAN Priority 3"
)

```


## Group all map variables

```{r}

# County Population
population_fields <- "Population"

# Race and Ethnicity: percentages only
demographic_fields <- grep(
  "\\(\\%\\)$",
  names(analysis_data),
  value = TRUE
)

demographic_fields <- demographic_fields[
  demographic_fields %in% c(
    "White (%)",
    "Black or African American (%)",
    "Hispanic (%)",
    "American Indian or Alaska Native (%)",
    "Asian, Native Hawaiian, or Pacific Islander (%)"
  )
]

# CHNA Priorities 1-3
chna_fields <- paste0("Priority ", 1:3, "_CHNA")

# IPLAN Priorities 1-3
iplan_fields <- paste0("Priority ", 1:3, "_IPLAN")

# Poverty: percentage only
poverty_fields <- "Poverty (%)"

# Uninsured: percentage only
uninsured_fields <- "Uninsured (%)"

# Hospital count only
hospital_fields <- "Number of Hospitals with CHNAS"

# Geographic Groups
geo_group_field <- "Geographic_Group"

# Organize dropdown
variable_groups <- list(
  "County Population" = population_fields,
  "Race and Ethnicity (%)" = demographic_fields,
  "CHNA Priorities" = chna_fields,
  "IPLAN Priorities" = iplan_fields,
  "Poverty Rate (%)" = poverty_fields,
  "Uninsured Rate (%)" = uninsured_fields,
  "Number of Hospitals" = hospital_fields,
  "Geographic Groups" = geo_group_field
)

# Remove unavailable fields
variable_groups <- lapply(variable_groups, function(x) {
  x[x %in% names(analysis_data)]
})

variable_groups <- variable_groups[lengths(variable_groups) > 0]

map_fields <- unique(unlist(variable_groups, use.names = FALSE))

# Convert groups to JSON
groups_json <- jsonlite::toJSON(
  variable_groups,
  auto_unbox = FALSE
)

```

## Check selected variables

```{r}


cat("\nMAP VARIABLES BY CATEGORY\n\n")

for (category in names(variable_groups)) {

  cat("\n", category, "\n", sep = "")

  print(variable_groups[[category]])
}

# Check for variables that were not found
if (length(population_fields) == 0) {
  warning("County population column was not detected.")
}

if (length(demographic_fields) == 0) {
  warning("Race and ethnicity columns were not detected.")
}

if (length(poverty_fields) == 0) {
  warning("Poverty rate column was not detected.")
}

if (length(uninsured_fields) == 0) {
  warning("Uninsured rate column was not detected.")
}

if (length(hospital_fields) == 0) {
  warning("Hospital count columns were not detected.")
}

```

## Create Illinois county boundaries

```{r}

illinois_counties <- maps::map(
  database = "county",
  regions = "illinois",
  plot = FALSE,
  fill = TRUE
)

ilco <- st_as_sf(illinois_counties)

ilco <- ilco %>%
  mutate(
    County_Key = ID %>%
      str_remove("^illinois,") %>%
      str_to_lower() %>%
      str_squish() %>%
      str_remove("\\s+county$")
  )

```

## Join county data to map

```{r}


county_data <- analysis_map_data %>%
  select(
    County,
    County_Key,
    all_of(map_fields)
  )

il_map_data <- ilco %>%
  left_join(
    county_data,
    by = "County_Key"
  )

# Verify county matches
matched_counties <- sum(
  !is.na(il_map_data$County)
)

cat(
  "Matched counties:",
  matched_counties,
  "of",
  nrow(il_map_data),
  "\n"
)

# Check unmatched counties
unmatched_counties <- il_map_data %>%
  filter(is.na(County))

if (nrow(unmatched_counties) > 0) {
  print(unmatched_counties$ID)
}

```
## Set priorty colors and map labels

```{r}

priority_colors <- c(
  "Behavioral and Mental Health" = "#4E79A7",
  "Access to Care and Healthcare Equity" = "#F28E2B",
  "Chronic Disease Management" = "#E15759",
  "Social Determinants of Health" = "#76B7B2",
  "Healthy Behaviors" = "#59A14F",
  "Community Safety" = "#EDC948",
  "Maternal and Child Health" = "#B07AA1",
  "Environmental Health" = "#FF9DA7",
  "Injury Prevention and Safety" = "#9C755F",
  "Healthcare Capacity" = "#BAB0AC"
)

# Friendly names for the dropdown
display_labels <- setNames(
  map_fields,
  map_fields
)

display_labels[names(priority_labels)] <- priority_labels

```

## Prepare map data for JavaScript

```{r}

map_records <- il_map_data %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  transmute(
    county_name = County,
    across(all_of(map_fields))
  )

records_json <- jsonlite::toJSON(
  map_records,
  dataframe = "rows",
  na = "null",
  auto_unbox = TRUE
)

groups_json <- jsonlite::toJSON(
  variable_groups,
  auto_unbox = FALSE
)

labels_json <- jsonlite::toJSON(
  as.list(display_labels),
  auto_unbox = TRUE
)

colors_json <- jsonlite::toJSON(
  as.list(priority_colors),
  auto_unbox = TRUE
)

geo_json <- jsonlite::toJSON(
  if (is.na(geo_group_field)) "" else geo_group_field,
  auto_unbox = TRUE
)

```

## Interactive map

```{r}

# Load Leaflet
library(leaflet)
library(dplyr)

# Create county map
map <- leaflet(il_map_data) %>%
  addProviderTiles(
    providers$CartoDB.Positron
  ) %>%
  addPolygons(
    layerId = ~County,
    group = "Counties",
    color = "#FFFFFF",
    weight = 1.2,
    opacity = 1,
    fillColor = "#DCEAF5",
    fillOpacity = 0.9,
    highlightOptions = highlightOptions(
      weight = 2.5,
      color = "#142D4E",
      bringToFront = TRUE
    ),
    label = ~County
  ) %>%
  fitBounds(
    lng1 = -91.6,
    lat1 = 36.9,
    lng2 = -87.4,
    lat2 = 42.6
  )

# Display map
map

```

## Add grouped dropdown, legend, and hover details

```{r}


map_css <- "
.map-controls {
  background: rgba(255,255,255,0.97);
  padding: 15px;
  border-radius: 8px;
  box-shadow: 0 2px 10px rgba(20,45,78,0.18);
  font-family: 'Times New Roman', serif;
  color: #142D4E;
  min-width: 245px;
}

.map-controls select {
  width: 100%;
  padding: 8px;
  margin-top: 8px;
  border: 1px solid #C7D4E2;
  border-radius: 4px;
  background: white;
  color: #142D4E;
}

.map-legend {
  background: rgba(255,255,255,0.97);
  padding: 12px 15px;
  border-radius: 8px;
  box-shadow: 0 2px 10px rgba(20,45,78,0.18);
  font-family: 'Times New Roman', serif;
  color: #142D4E;
}

.legend-item {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  margin: 5px 0;
  font-size: 13px;
}

.legend-color {
  width: 13px;
  height: 13px;
  margin-right: 8px;
  border: 1px solid #999;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.leaflet-tooltip {
  background: white;
  border: 1px solid #D5DFE9;
  color: #26374A;
  font-family: 'Times New Roman', serif;
  border-radius: 5px;
}
"

map_js <- "
function(el, x) {

  var map = this;

  var records = DATA_RECORDS;
  var groups = VARIABLE_GROUPS;
  var labels = DISPLAY_LABELS;
  var priorityColors = PRIORITY_COLORS;
  var geographicField = GEOGRAPHIC_FIELD;

  var geoPalette = [
    '#4E79A7', '#F28E2B', '#59A14F',
    '#B07AA1', '#E15759', '#76B7B2',
    '#9C755F', '#EDC948'
  ];

  var geoColors = {};

  var panel = L.control({position: 'topright'});

  panel.onAdd = function() {

    var div = L.DomUtil.create('div', 'map-controls');

    div.innerHTML =
      '<strong>Illinois County Health Indicators</strong>' +
      '<br><label>Select variable</label>' +
      '<select id=\"indicator-select\"></select>';

    L.DomEvent.disableClickPropagation(div);

    return div;
  };

  panel.addTo(map);

  var selector = document.getElementById('indicator-select');

  Object.keys(groups).forEach(function(category) {

    var optgroup = document.createElement('optgroup');
    optgroup.label = category;

    groups[category].forEach(function(field) {

      var option = document.createElement('option');
      option.value = field;
      option.textContent = labels[field] || field;

      optgroup.appendChild(option);
    });

    selector.appendChild(optgroup);
  });

  var legend = L.control({position: 'bottomright'});

  legend.onAdd = function() {
    var div = L.DomUtil.create('div', 'map-legend');
    div.id = 'county-map-legend';
    return div;
  };

  legend.addTo(map);

  function getRecord(county) {

    return records.find(function(row) {
      return row.county_name === county;
    });
  }

  function getValues(field) {

    return records.map(function(row) {
      return Number(row[field]);
    }).filter(function(value) {
      return Number.isFinite(value);
    });
  }

  function getColor(value, field) {

    if (value === null || value === undefined || value === '') {
      return '#D9E2EC';
    }

    var textValue = String(value);

    if (priorityColors[textValue]) {
      return priorityColors[textValue];
    }

    if (field === geographicField) {

      if (!geoColors[textValue]) {
        var index = Object.keys(geoColors).length;
        geoColors[textValue] =
          geoPalette[index % geoPalette.length];
      }

      return geoColors[textValue];
    }

    var numericValue = Number(value);

    if (!Number.isFinite(numericValue)) {
      return '#D9E2EC';
    }

    var values = getValues(field);

    if (values.length === 0) {
      return '#D9E2EC';
    }

    var min = Math.min.apply(null, values);
    var max = Math.max.apply(null, values);

    if (min === max) {
      return '#4E79A7';
    }

    var p = (numericValue - min) / (max - min);

    if (p < 0.25) return '#EFF3F8';
    if (p < 0.50) return '#BDD7E7';
    if (p < 0.75) return '#6BAED6';

    return '#2171B5';
  }

  function updateLegend(field) {

    var html =
      '<strong>' + (labels[field] || field) + '</strong>';

    var values = Array.from(new Set(
      records.map(function(row) {
        return row[field];
      }).filter(function(value) {
        return value !== null &&
          value !== undefined &&
          value !== '';
      })
    ));

    var categorical = field === geographicField ||
      values.some(function(value) {
        return !Number.isFinite(Number(value)) ||
          priorityColors[String(value)];
      });

    if (categorical) {

      values.forEach(function(value) {

        html +=
          '<div class=\"legend-item\">' +
          '<span class=\"legend-color\" style=\"background:' +
          getColor(value, field) + '\"></span>' +
          value +
          '</div>';
      });

    } else {

      html +=
        '<div class=\"legend-item\">' +
        '<span class=\"legend-color\" style=\"background:#EFF3F8\"></span>' +
        'Lower values</div>' +
        '<div class=\"legend-item\">' +
        '<span class=\"legend-color\" style=\"background:#BDD7E7\"></span>' +
        'Moderate values</div>' +
        '<div class=\"legend-item\">' +
        '<span class=\"legend-color\" style=\"background:#6BAED6\"></span>' +
        'Higher values</div>' +
        '<div class=\"legend-item\">' +
        '<span class=\"legend-color\" style=\"background:#2171B5\"></span>' +
        'Highest values</div>';
    }

    html +=
      '<div class=\"legend-item\">' +
      '<span class=\"legend-color\" style=\"background:#D9E2EC\"></span>' +
      'No data</div>';

    document.getElementById('county-map-legend').innerHTML = html;
  }

  function hoverContent(record) {

    if (!record) return 'No data available';

    var html =
      '<strong>' + record.county_name + '</strong>';

    if (geographicField && record[geographicField] != null) {
      html += '<br><strong>Geographic Group:</strong> ' +
        record[geographicField];
    }

    html += '<hr style=\"margin:6px 0;\">';

    var hoverFields = [
      'Priority 1_CHNA',
      'Priority 2_CHNA',
      'Priority 3_CHNA',
      'Priority 1_IPLAN',
      'Priority 2_IPLAN',
      'Priority 3_IPLAN'
    ];

    hoverFields.forEach(function(field) {

      var value = record[field];

      if (value !== null && value !== undefined && value !== '') {

        html +=
          '<div><strong>' + labels[field] + ':</strong> ' +
          value + '</div>';
      }
    });

    return html;
  }

  function updateMap(field) {

    map.eachLayer(function(layer) {

      var county = layer.options && layer.options.layerId;

      if (!county || !layer.setStyle) return;

      var record = getRecord(county);

      var value = record ? record[field] : null;

      layer.setStyle({
        fillColor: getColor(value, field),
        fillOpacity: 0.9,
        color: '#FFFFFF',
        weight: 1.2
      });
    });

    updateLegend(field);
  }

  map.eachLayer(function(layer) {

    var county = layer.options && layer.options.layerId;

    if (!county || !layer.bindTooltip) return;

    var record = getRecord(county);

    if (record) {
      layer.bindTooltip(hoverContent(record), {
        sticky: true,
        direction: 'auto'
      });

      layer.bindPopup(hoverContent(record));
    }
  });

  selector.addEventListener('change', function() {
    updateMap(this.value);
  });

  // Start with the first available variable
  updateMap(selector.value);
}
"

# Insert data into JavaScript
map_js <- sub(
  "DATA_RECORDS",
  as.character(records_json),
  map_js,
  fixed = TRUE
)

map_js <- sub(
  "VARIABLE_GROUPS",
  as.character(groups_json),
  map_js,
  fixed = TRUE
)

map_js <- sub(
  "DISPLAY_LABELS",
  as.character(labels_json),
  map_js,
  fixed = TRUE
)

map_js <- sub(
  "PRIORITY_COLORS",
  as.character(colors_json),
  map_js,
  fixed = TRUE
)

map_js <- sub(
  "GEOGRAPHIC_FIELD",
  as.character(geo_json),
  map_js,
  fixed = TRUE
)

map <- htmlwidgets::onRender(
  map,
  map_js
)

map <- htmlwidgets::prependContent(
  map,
  htmltools::tags$style(
    htmltools::HTML(map_css)
  )
)

```

## Save and open

```{r}

output_folder <- path.expand(
  "~/Desktop/apex/_site/docs"
)

if (!dir.exists(output_folder)) {
  dir.create(
    output_folder,
    recursive = TRUE
  )
}

output_file <- file.path(
  output_folder,
  "map.html"
)

htmlwidgets::saveWidget(
  map,
  file = output_file,
  selfcontained = TRUE
)

cat("Map saved to:", output_file, "\n")

browseURL(output_file)

```
